stem: Ex-vitro rooting succeeds for one genotype but not another. What is the strongest operational response?
choices: Retain genotype-specific rooting/acclimatization workflows and validate before standardizing
Force both genotypes through the same method
Assume the lower-performing genotype is contaminated
rationale: Rooting and acclimatization performance can be genotype-dependent, so transition methods should be validated rather than universally imposed.
